title: Savaki
overview: Savaki is a 3D one-on-one fighting game for one or two players which aims to recreate various martial arts in a realistic way. There are seven fighters to choose from, each representing a particular martial art, such as boxing, muay thai, or taekwando. Three game modes are included: a single-player arcade mode, a two-player versus mode, and a practice mode. There is no story mode, and only a single arena to fight in.
